items.description: One placeable camera composed from a reference frame, local motion, framing policy, lens, and render target.

name.description: The camera's stable name — the handle a View screen / layout slot samples by.

rig.description: The independent local motion, aim, and lens axes.

name.description: The stable name a Blend op selects this program by.

operations.description: The selected ops, in authored evaluation order.

anchorOp.description: Gets the program's Anchor op, or null when absent (an absent anchor starts from Reference implicitly).

blendOp.description: Gets the program's Blend op, or null.

clampPitchOp.description: Gets the program's ClampPitch op, or null.

dynamicsOp.description: Gets the program's Dynamics op, or null.

fovOp.description: Gets the program's FieldOfView op, or null.

lookAtOp.description: Gets the program's LookAt op, or null.

offsetOp.description: Gets the program's Offset op, or null.

orbitOp.description: Gets the program's Orbit op, or null.

pathOp.description: Gets the program's Path op, or null.

selectOp.description: Gets the program's SelectProgram op, or null.

rig.title: WorldCameraProgram

renderWidth.description: The offscreen render width in pixels.

renderHeight.description: The offscreen render height in pixels.

anchor.description: What the camera rides, or null for the world reference frame (or for Anchors to decide).

anchors.description: Ranked anchor candidates, first holding wins each frame — a portrait camera that rides the speaking character while they speak and the seat's own avatar otherwise. Refused beside Anchor; a single unconditional anchor is Anchor.

items.description: One ranked anchor candidate of a WorldCamera: the anchor the camera rides while When holds. Candidates are walked in authored order every frame and the first holding one wins; a null predicate always holds, so the last row is the default.

anchor.description: What the camera rides while this candidate wins.

when.description: The condition, evaluated for the seat the view is resolved for.
